id: 08_SHARQ Safety Officer Interview Questions and Answers - Eastern petrochemical com
title: 安全知识问答：制度、红线与不安全行为
source_doc: course/ACS Hazard Communication & Safety/08_SHARQ Safety Officer Interview Questions and Answers - Eastern petrochemical com.md
author_source: project/ACS Hazard Communication & Safety/08_SHARQ Safety Officer Interview Questions and Answers - Eastern petrochemical com/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 欢迎回来！今天分享一场石化厂面试。
overlay: 安全知识问答：制度、红线与不安全行为

shots.scene: 石化厂剪影，旁边十五个小方格
shots.prompt_en: A silhouette of a petrochemical plant next to fifteen small squares in a grid. No people.
shots.narration: 一共十五道题，答案写在白板上。

shots.scene: 阿杰戴着安全帽走进石化厂的面试室
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in a hard hat walks into an interview room at a petrochemical plant.
shots.narration: 阿杰去石化厂面试安全员。

shots.scene: 老周把一叠空白题卡推到桌上
shots.prompt_en: The older man slides a stack of blank question cards across the desk.
shots.narration: 我们看看都考了什么。

shots.scene: 一叠空白程序文件，旁边盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: A stack of blank procedure documents next to a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 安全工作制度：一套作业程序。

shots.scene: 按程序作业，事故图标变小
shots.prompt_en: Workers follow numbered steps and a large accident icon shrinks to a tiny one. No people.
shots.narration: 照着做，现场事故和伤害能降到最低。

shots.scene: 空白作业许可证亮起
shots.prompt_en: A blank work permit card lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 比如作业许可制度。

shots.scene: 八张许可证卡片，前四张亮起
shots.prompt_en: Eight blank permit cards in a row; the first four light up with icons: a wrench, a flame, a manhole and a lightning bolt. No people.
shots.narration: 许可分八类：一般、动火、受限、电气。

shots.scene: 后四张亮起
shots.prompt_en: The last four permit cards light up with icons: a radiation symbol, a crane hook, a shovel and a water jet. No people.
shots.narration: 射线探伤、吊装、开挖、高压水射流。

shots.scene: 十个盾牌图标排成两行
shots.prompt_en: Ten shield icons arranged in two rows of five. No people.
shots.narration: 企业有十条保命规则。

shots.scene: 前五个盾牌亮起
shots.prompt_en: The first five shields light up with icons: a permit, a manhole, a ladder, a crane hook and a cut pipe. No people.
shots.narration: 安全工作制度、受限空间、高处、吊装。

shots.scene: 第五个盾牌：断开的管线
shots.prompt_en: The fifth shield shows a pipe being opened at a flange. No people.
shots.narration: 还有管线打开。

shots.scene: 后五个盾牌亮起
shots.prompt_en: The last five shields light up with icons: a padlock, a hole in the floor, an alarm with a slash, a car and a change arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 能量隔离、开口作业、不停用安全系统。

shots.scene: 车辆和变更箭头盾牌
shots.prompt_en: The car shield and the change arrow shield glow. No people.
shots.narration: 车辆安全和变更管理。

shots.scene: 一项作业被切成几段，每段一个警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A long task arrow is cut into segments, each with a small warning triangle and a blank control card. No people.
shots.narration: JSA：分步骤找危害和措施的书面过程。

shots.scene: 四级台阶图标
shots.prompt_en: Four stairs, each with an icon: a pointing hand, a cut arrow, a magnifying glass and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: JSA步骤：选作业，分解成步骤。

shots.scene: 小研在空白分析表上逐行填写
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student fills in rows of a blank analysis sheet.
shots.narration: 识别潜在危害，确定预防措施。

shots.scene: 三个脚手架挂牌：红、黄、绿
shots.prompt_en: Three blank tags hanging on scaffolds: a red tag, a yellow tag and a green tag. No people.
shots.narration: 脚手架标签分三色。

shots.scene: 红牌旁一个停止手势
shots.prompt_en: The red tag with a stop hand icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 红牌：禁止使用。

shots.scene: 黄牌旁安全带图标，绿牌旁绿勾
shots.prompt_en: The yellow tag with a full-body harness icon, and the green tag with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 黄牌系全身安全带可用，绿牌不用系。

shots.scene: 五个图标：低氧表、高氧表、暗灯泡、停转风扇、骷髅气团
shots.prompt_en: Five icons: a low oxygen gauge, a high oxygen gauge, a dim bulb, a stopped fan and a gas cloud with a skull and a flame. No people.
shots.narration: 受限空间：缺氧、富氧、照明通风差。

shots.scene: 骷髅火焰气团亮起
shots.prompt_en: The gas cloud with skull and flame pictograms glows. No people.
shots.narration: 还有有毒和可燃气体。

shots.scene: 氧气表指针掉到红区
shots.prompt_en: An oxygen gauge with its needle dropping into the low red zone. No people.
shots.narration: 缺氧：环境中氧含量低于19.5%。

shots.scene: 白板写到一半翻页
shots.prompt_en: A whiteboard answer is cut off halfway as the page flips. No people.
shots.narration: 原片答案只写到这里就翻页了。

shots.scene: 氧气表指针升到高处红区，旁边问号
shots.prompt_en: An oxygen gauge with its needle rising into the high red zone, a question mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 下一题：什么是富氧？

shots.scene: 欣欣摊手，白板空白
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot shrugs beside a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 原片只出了题，没有给出答案。

shots.scene: 老李刷漆，旁边一份空白说明书
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer paints a steel rail with a blank safety data sheet pinned nearby.
shots.narration: 刷漆安全：遵守化学品安全技术说明书。

shots.scene: 刷漆区周围画出一圈距离，火焰图标被划掉
shots.prompt_en: A circle drawn around the painting area with a distance arrow, and a flame icon outside it crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 周围10米内避免动火。

shots.scene: 老李戴手套口罩，桶下放托盘
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wears gloves and a mask; the paint can sits in a drip tray.
shots.narration: 用合适的防护装备，用托盘防洒漏。

shots.scene: 空油漆桶被搬走
shots.prompt_en: Empty unwanted paint drums are carried away from the work area. No people.
shots.narration: 清走不用的油漆桶。

shots.scene: 喷砂枪图标，旁边粉尘、耳朵、振动图标
shots.prompt_en: A sandblasting nozzle icon next to icons of a dust cloud, an ear with sound waves and vibration lines. No people.
shots.narration: 喷砂危害：粉尘、噪声、振动。

shots.scene: 两张模糊的卡片
shots.prompt_en: Two blurred blank cards with question marks. No people.
shots.narration: 另外两条，原片看不清。

shots.scene: 铁锹图标和挖掘机图标
shots.prompt_en: A shovel icon and an excavator icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 开挖分人工和机械两种。

shots.scene: 红色挂锁和空白挂牌挂在已隔离的电闸上
shots.prompt_en: A red padlock and a blank tag hang on an isolated switch. No people.
shots.narration: LOTO：在隔离设备上加锁挂牌。

shots.scene: 一只手伸向电闸，被红叉挡住
shots.prompt_en: A hand reaching for the locked switch is blocked by a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 防止有人擅自操作。

shots.scene: 两个工人在设备旁打闹
shots.prompt_en: Two worker pictograms push each other playfully next to a machine, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不安全行为：人做出的不安全动作。

shots.scene: 没戴安全帽和手套的工人图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A worker pictogram without a hard hat or gloves, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 比如打闹嬉戏、不用防护装备。

shots.scene: 杂乱的过道和烈日图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a cluttered walkway and a blazing sun over a work site. No people.
shots.narration: 不安全状态：会伤人的工作场所状况。

shots.scene: 两个图标带红色感叹号
shots.prompt_en: The cluttered walkway icon and the blazing sun icon, each with a red exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 比如内务管理差、高温天气。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现许可证和盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating permit and shield icons.
shots.narration: 工作制度、八类许可、十条规则。

shots.scene: JSA台阶和三色标签图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of four stairs and three colored tags. No people.
shots.narration: JSA步骤，脚手架三色标签。

shots.scene: 氧气表、油漆桶、喷砂枪图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an oxygen gauge, a paint can and a sandblasting nozzle. No people.
shots.narration: 受限空间、刷漆和喷砂。

shots.scene: 挂锁、打闹、杂乱过道图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a padlock, two workers pushing each other and a cluttered walkway. No people.
shots.narration: 上锁挂牌，不安全行为和状态。

shots.scene: 欣欣在白板前鞠躬挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot bows and waves goodbye in front of the whiteboard.
shots.narration: 谢谢观看，下期见！
